subject.size_in_frame: a spark on top of the tabletop, about 0.03 of frame height — smaller in frame than it has ever been, and still the brightest thing in the hall

second_subject.note: two feet high, looking back up the hall; her tiny reflection lies in the wet flagstone below the table.

headroom: about 0.24 of frame height above her, and the table edge crosses it well above her head — the 0.715 m table is now a high shelf and the frame says so by putting it above her eyeline.
horizon_eyeline: Along the curtain-to-table axis, lens 0.55 m. The flooded floor runs across at 0.74 of frame height and doubles everything above it. Her eyeline goes up-right at about twenty degrees to the tabletop — for the first time since S06 she is looking up at that table again.

layers.fg: the wet flagstone and shallow water at the bottom of frame, holding her tiny reflection
layers.mg: Alice, small, turned to look back
layers.bg: the glass table standing in the flood, the key a spark on its top edge, the dark hall beyond

gaze.note: her look crosses the whole frame diagonally up to the key. The lead room is the distance and the height between them, and both have got worse.

balance: A long diagonal from the small figure at bottom left to the small spark at top right, with a flooded floor doubling the whole thing. Two tiny bright points in a large dark picture.
leading_lines: The waterline and its reflections run level under everything; the glass legs are verticals that connect the floor to the shelf. The eye climbs them from her to the key, which is exactly the journey she cannot make.
eye_first: The key, because it still holds the highest specular value in the hall — then down the legs to the girl.
constraint_binding: The one image of the scene, and the key is still the brightest thing in the hall — the value relationship established in sh037 is held here for the last time, with the key outshining everything including the lamp reflections on the water.
